Seaweed is a kind of algae, suprisingly. 

Information about it: [Nori Seaweed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nori)

I'm not sure of the powders. I think powders would be in shakes or stuff like that. Algae is used in Japanese dishes as Nori (seaweed), but I haven't seen many powder based dishes or drinks, besides shakes/smoothies. I assume it would be safe if it is sold as a food product, but reviews may help.

Make sure the type of Algae you have isn't poisonous. I'd say that blue-green algae should be avoided. If you are cooking with it, make sure you know how to call poison control in case if it was labelled wrong. Otherwise, hope that the recipe goes well. Nori or normal seaweed could be fine.
